contract.task_clause:
An individual is born with a mutation causing her to partially retain a form of fetal hemoglobin into adulthood. Compared to a normal individual, this person would exhibit:
Option A: no differences from a normal adult.
Option B: significantly reduced oxygen binding in the lungs.
Option C: no symptoms, since retention of fetal hemoglobin would be fatal.
Option D: increased oxygen binding to hemoglobin in the tissues.
